question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.year,
        c.constructor_id,
        c.constructor_ref,
        SUM(r.points) as constructor_points
    FROM races ra
    JOIN results r ON ra.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE ra.year >= 2001
      AND r.points > 0
    GROUP BY ra.year, c.constructor_id, c.constructor_ref
),
season_min AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(constructor_points) as min_p
    FROM season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_min_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.constructor_id,
        sp.constructor_ref,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.year = sp.year AND sp.constructor_points = sm.min_p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as min_season_count
    FROM season_points sp
    JOIN season_min sm ON sp.year = sm.year
    GROUP BY sp.constructor_id, sp.constructor_ref
)
SELECT constructor_ref, CAST(min_season_count AS BIGINT) as min_season_count
FROM constructor_min_seasons
ORDER BY min_season_count DESC, constructor_ref
LIMIT 5
